# PiTTy v0.6.39

This release fixes the long black screen that could appear at startup on terminals wide enough to show the sidebar.

## Startup fix

- Normal sidebar rendering no longer scans every historical profiled-subagent runtime directory.
- Sidebar subagent targets are memoized instead of recomputed repeatedly during layout.
- Historical fallback scanning remains available explicitly for code paths that actually need it.

On the reproduced machine, the same 140x46 launch changed from roughly **18.9 s** between renderer creation and UI mount to roughly **0.08 s**.

## Upgrade repair

PiTTy v0.6.38 introduced a prebuilt runtime, but a machine upgraded to it by the older v0.6.37 upgrader could end up with v0.6.38 source files and no generated dist/. Upgrading to v0.6.39 runs the newer installer and repairs that state automatically.

The v0.6.38 runtime build command also missed OpenTUI Solid's required Bun build plugin. v0.6.39 uses the documented @opentui/solid/bun-plugin build path, so the generated runtime mounts correctly instead of selecting an invalid Solid rendering path.

Correct plugin builds now carry a marker. Markerless dist/ output created by an older installer is ignored, so the launcher safely falls back to the fixed source runtime instead of executing an incompatible prebuild.

The existing 60-second Pi RPC tolerance, bounded diagnostic logs, and pi-subagent v0.5.6 startup-handshake fix remain unchanged.
